notes: The post says this is the Light deck Tim played at FreedomCon (2001 Decipher World Championship); format set to Premiere - Reflections III per Bill's FreedomCon ruling. No finish is given, and the strategy says he added about one card since then.

Starting cards: We'll Handle This (Objective), Heading For The Medical Frigate (posted with the Interrupts) and An Unusual Amount Of Fear (posted under 'Starting Effect'); Insurrection & Aim High and Another Pathetic Lifeform are marked 'start Always', Your Insight Serves You Well 'start sometimes', Sando Aqua Monster 'only if they start Colo'. All count toward the 60.

Posted 'Obi-Wan's lightsaber (destiny 2 one)' dested the destiny-2 Reflections III Obi-Wan's Lightsaber (the Premiere one is destiny 1); 'Qui-Gon's Lightsaber (destiny 5)' dested the destiny-5 Reflections III Qui-Gon's Lightsaber.
Posted 'Your Insight Serves you Well' dested the Death Star II Effect (posted alone, not the Staging Areas combo); 'Insurrection/Aim High' dested Insurrection & Aim High.

Posted 'Epp Luke' dested Luke With Lightsaber; 'Shocking Info/Grimtaash' dested Shocking Information & Grimtaash; 'Out Of Commission/Trans terminated' dested Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated; 'Control/Tunnel Vision' dested Control & Tunnel Vision; 'I hope she's Alright' dested I Hope She's All Right; 'Strangle(Yes tech against Ig-88)' dested the Jabba's Palace Interrupt Strangle.
Section headers ('Epic Events', 'Weapons and Devices', 'Starting Effect') and the shields remark were not cards and are dropped.
